content.text: The IP framework fully matches our preferred position, with no conflicting assignment or joint-ownership language elsewhere.

input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel. Vendor will execute further documents reasonably needed to confirm ownership.
input.rationale: Section 14 delivers the preferred position in full and in our favour. 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right to provide, secure, support and improve the Services for Customer. 14.2 vests ownership of each Deliverable in Customer upon creation with an express present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further-assurances; the payment condition is a market-standard qualifier, not a walk-away issue. 14.3 leaves Vendor with only its pre-existing Vendor Technology and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the Section 13.2 licence, which is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, including rights to modify, create derivative works and use contractors for Customer's business — meeting (indeed exceeding) both preferred and fallback licence-back requirements. 14.4 expressly negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument specifying exploitation rights, and keeps feedback voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted rights in its own feedback. The definitions do not undercut this: "Vendor Technology" (1.8) excludes Customer Data and Customer's pre-existing IP and anything embodying Customer Confidential Information, and "Customer Data" (1.3) captures submitted material plus derived output, excluding only non-attributable anonymized telemetry. 15.1 further limits processing and bars sale, advertising use, cross-customer combination and model training without our written consent. Searches for competing assignment, licence-to-Vendor, improvements or derivative-works grants returned nothing adverse. No redline is warranted.
